description: Defines the PredefinedChart class which provides methods to generate SQL queries for various predefined charts in SuiteCRM, including sales pipeline, lead source outcomes, monthly outcomes, lead source pipeline, and module usage statistics.

classes.name: PredefinedChart
classes.description: A class that generates SQL queries for various predefined chart visualizations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: predefinedChartQuery
methods.description: Dispatches to specific query methods based on chart type.

methods.name: pipelineBySalesStageQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for sales pipeline by sales stage, considering user preferences and filters.

methods.name: leadSourceByOutcomeQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for lead source outcome analysis based on filters.

methods.name: outcomeByMonthQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for monthly outcome data within user-specified date ranges.

methods.name: pipelineByLeadSourceQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for pipeline data grouped by lead source, considering user filters.

methods.name: myModuleUsageLast30Days
methods.description: Generates SQL to retrieve module usage statistics for the last 30 days.

methods.name: customChartQuery
methods.description: Loads and executes a custom chart query from the custom directory if available.
